description: ContextSelectionAndFireAndForget ords 0-2: two invalid fire-and-forget compiles pin the context-partition join rejections over context-bound named windows (ord 0); a keyed length(5) aggregate statement exercises the iterator-selector matrix — default/all/by-id {0,1,2}/{1}/empty/null sets, a nil selector, and a non-context statement — with ordered rows and partition descriptors (ord 1); a context-bound keepall named window fed by insert-into answers fire-and-forget queries without a context clause, with a context clause, and under all/segmented/by-id selectors, plus a category-selector invalid-selector rejection (ord 2).

cases.observation: compile-error; five fixture deploys register two segmented contexts, two context-bound keepall windows and one context-free window; the first probe joins two context-bound windows under a context clause, the second joins two context-bound windows without one; G1/G2 events materialize one partition per key before the second probe
cases.epl: context SegmentedSB select * from WinSB, WinS0

cases.observation: listener+snapshot+snapshot-selector+selector-error; one module deploys the keyed context and s0 (context.key1 plus per-partition sum over length(5)); E1/E2/E2 deliver three listener rows; the default iterator and the all/by-id {0,1,2} selectors yield {E1,10},{E2,41} in order, by-id {1} yields {E2,41}, empty and null id sets yield no rows, a nil selector fails with 'No selector provided', and the context-free s2 fails with 'Iterator with context selector is only supported for statements under context'
cases.epl: @Name('s0') context PartitionedByString select context.key1 as c0, sum(intPrimitive) as c1 from SupportBean#length(5)

cases.observation: faf+selector-error; a keyed context, a context-bound keepall window and an insert-into feed materialize partitions E1={10} and E2={20,21}; context-free sums pin 51 and 41, segmented {E2} and by-id {1} pin 41, context-clause queries pin all three rows and the filtered pair, and a category selector over the keyed context is rejected as an invalid context partition selector
cases.epl: context PartitionedByString select context.key1 as c0, intPrimitive as c1 from MyWindow

steps.epl: @public create context SegmentedSB as partition by theString from SupportBean
@public create context SegmentedS0 as partition by p00 from SupportBean_S0
@public context SegmentedSB create window WinSB#keepall as SupportBean
@public context SegmentedS0 create window WinS0#keepall as SupportBean_S0
@public create window WinS1#keepall as SupportBean_S1
context SegmentedSB select * from WinSB, WinS0
steps.expectError: Joins in runtime queries for context partitions are not supported

steps.epl: @public create context PartitionedByString partition by theString from SupportBean
@public context PartitionedByString create window MyWindowOne#keepall as SupportBean
@public create context PartitionedByP00 partition by p00 from SupportBean_S0
@public context PartitionedByP00 create window MyWindowTwo#keepall as SupportBean_S0
select mw1.intPrimitive as c1, mw2.id as c2 from MyWindowOne mw1, MyWindowTwo mw2 where mw1.theString = mw2.p00
steps.expectError: Joins against named windows that are under context are not supported

steps.epl:
create context PartitionedByString partition by theString from SupportBean;
@Name('s0') context PartitionedByString select context.key1 as c0, sum(intPrimitive) as c1 from SupportBean#length(5);
@name('s2') select * from SupportBean

steps.expectError: Iterator with context selector is only supported for statements under context
